incident: Judge attachment was selected on an inactive duplicated composer file input
scope: Research-only attachment adapter; existing gateway, browser and authentication preserved
observations: J1 through J4 recovery01 returned INPUT_INCOMPLETE and attested no file available.
Sentinel02 selected the first general file input, had no visible attachment chip in the pre-send screenshot, and returned INPUT_INCOMPLETE.
Page had six file inputs including two empty-accept general inputs.
Sentinel03 selected the last general input, required a visible filename outside editable text, displayed an attachment chip, and returned the file-only sentinel SILVER-OTTER-73914 in 37.468 seconds.
J1 recovery02 explicitly reported reading all 24 raw report boundaries, all 25 audit boundaries, and matching the 24 manifest report hashes.
repair: Use final general attachment input and fail closed unless every filename is visible outside editable content; preserve upload DOM and pre-send screenshot
limitations: Active input selection uses observed current DOM ordering. Visible chip validation prevents silent submission if this ordering changes. Transport success alone still does not prove a judge read all inputs.
